correctness.rationale: For embedded C8 strictly convex arclength curve, compactness localizes small Euclidean chords near the diagonal. Midpoint coordinates u=(s+s')/2,h=s'-s give probability 2/L² times the integral of positive inverse chord length H(u,t). Frenet differentiation yields chord length h-kappa²h³/24+[kappa⁴/1920-kappa kappa''/480-(kappa')²/1440]h⁵+O(h⁷); formal inversion and periodic integration by parts produce the displayed t⁵ coefficient (3/320)int kappa⁴-(1/360)int(kappa')². Total curvature 2pi gives sharp circle cubic minimum. Harmonic theta(s)=rho s+(a/n)sin(n rho s), n>=2, makes a closed positive-curvature curve; exact curvature averages give coefficient difference rho⁴ a²/L[9/320-n²/720+9a²/2560], positive for modes 2–4, negative for >=5, tending to minus infinity for n->infty at fixed a. Error is O_Gamma(t⁷) separately for each fixed curve.
